## 简体中文

- 日志弹窗新增作业侧栏，可以在自己正在运行的作业之间切换，并沿用 `.out` / `.err` 和跟踪设置。顶部标题简化为「作业」。
- Slurm 表格用「GPU 编号」替换「节点数」。分配多张卡时用逗号分隔编号，暂无编号时显示 `—`。

## English

- Switch between your running jobs from the log viewer sidebar while keeping the selected output and follow setting. The viewer now uses the title “Jobs”.
- Replace the node count in the Slurm table with allocated GPU IDs. Multiple IDs appear comma-separated, and unavailable IDs appear as `—`.
